text: ITR-2 is applicable to individuals and HUFs who do not have income from business or profession and have income such as capital gains, multiple house properties, or foreign assets.
ITR-2 cannot be used by taxpayers having income from business or profession. Such taxpayers must file ITR-3 or another applicable form.
Provide personal details such as PAN, Aadhaar, address, filing status, and nature of employment. These details must match official records.
This section captures salary income received from one or more employers, including allowances, perquisites, and profits in lieu of salary.
Report income or loss from one or more house properties, including interest on borrowed capital and details of let-out or self-occupied properties.
Enter interest paid on housing loan for each property. Loss from house property may be subject to set-off limits as per law.
This section reports short-term and long-term capital gains arising from sale of assets such as shares, mutual funds, property, or other capital assets.
Report short-term capital gains separately based on applicable tax rates, including gains under section 111A, if any.
Report long-term capital gains from sale of assets, apply indexation where applicable, and claim eligible exemptions under relevant sections.
This section captures income such as interest, dividends, family pension, winnings, and other taxable receipts not covered elsewhere.
Report income that is exempt from tax, such as certain dividends or agricultural income, for disclosure purposes.
Resident taxpayers must disclose details of foreign assets, foreign bank accounts, and income from sources outside India in the applicable schedules.
Schedule FA captures details of foreign assets held during the year, including financial interest, signing authority, and foreign trusts.
Schedule AL requires disclosure of movable and immovable assets and liabilities if total income exceeds the prescribed threshold.
Claim deductions under Chapter VI-A such as sections 80C, 80D, 80G, and other eligible deductions in this section.
Enter eligible investments or payments under section 80C, such as PPF, LIC, ELSS, EPF, or tuition fees, subject to the overall limit.
This section computes tax liability based on total income, applicable slab rates, surcharge, health and education cess, and rebates.
Eligible resident individuals may claim rebate under section 87A if total income is within the specified threshold.
Report tax deducted or collected at source as per Form 16, Form 16A, or Form 26AS and ensure details match the certificates.
Provide details of advance tax and self-assessment tax paid, including challan identification number, BSR code, and date of payment.
Provide details of all bank accounts held during the year and select one account for receiving any income tax refund.
Ensure income details reported in the return match information available in Form 26AS and AIS to avoid notices or processing delays.
Verify the return using e-verification methods or by submitting ITR-V within the prescribed time to complete the filing process.
The return is treated as invalid if verification is not completed within the allowed period after submission.
